claims.claim: The United States beat Peru 4-1 in Orlando on Saturday, and 19-year-old Justin Ellis scored in the fourth minute on his first national-team appearance, with eleven debutants and two teenage scorers in the match.
claims.episode_span: The United States beat Peru 4-1 in Orlando on Saturday. Justin Ellis, 19, scored in the fourth minute
claims.source_title: In playful moments, the USMNT’s new youth movement is already paying off

It came just four minutes into the match, only moments after 19-year-old Orlando City attacker Justin Ellis headed home the US opener.
